title: 1970 Chinese Zodiac: Year of the Metal Dog
seo_title: 1970 Chinese Zodiac: Year of the Metal Dog (6 February – 26 January 1971)
description: 1970 is the Year of the Metal Dog (Yang, Geng-xu), from 6 February 1970 to 26 January 1971. Personality, lucky colors and numbers, best matches, and what to know if you were born in January or February 1970.
lead: Born in 1970? Your Chinese zodiac animal is most likely the Dog, but check the date: the 1970 Metal Dog year began on 6 February 1970. Here is everything about the year, from its element to its lucky colors and best matches.
card_text: 1970: Year of the Metal Dog, from 6 February 1970 to 26 January 1971.

paras: The Chinese zodiac year 1970 was the Year of the Dog. It began with Lunar New Year on 6 February 1970 and ended on 26 January 1971, the eve of the next Lunar New Year.

Each year also has an element and a Yin or Yang quality. 1970 ends in 0, which makes it a Metal year, and as an even year it is Yang. In the traditional stem-and-branch count, 1970 is a Geng-xu year. The same Metal Dog combination comes round only once every 60 years: 1910 before it and 2030 after it.
Lunar New Year 1970 fell on 6 February 1970, so everyone born in January 1970, and in February before that date, belongs to the previous year's animal, the Rooster.

The zodiac year starts at Lunar New Year, not on 1 January, which is why early-year birthdays need checking. Our guide Born in January? explains the rule, and the zodiac sign checker gives the exact answer for any birth date.

Our Dog guide describes the sign like this: “Loyal, honest, and protective. Dogs are deeply trustworthy and stand up for what they believe in.” The usual watch-out: “Can be anxious or overly suspicious of new situations.”

The Metal element adds its own flavour. Metal years bring discipline, ambition, and strong will. People of this element tend to be determined, independent, and value-driven. Read more in our Metal element guide, or the full Year of the Dog page.
Careers often linked with the Dog: law, security, social work, education.

sections.h2: Best matches for someone born in 1970
paras: In traditional compatibility, the Dog's best matches are the Tiger, Horse and Rabbit, and its clash sign is the Dragon, which sits directly opposite it on the zodiac circle. Our compatibility calculator compares two full birth dates, elements included.
2026 (Fire Horse, until 5 February 2027): for the Dog, it shares the Horse's triangle, so 2026 is traditionally one of its friendlier years.
2027 (Fire Goat, from 6 February 2027): for the Dog, it has no special traditional relationship with the Goat, so 2027 is a neutral year. See Chinese zodiac 2027 predictions for every sign.

sections.h2: Other Year of the Dog years
paras: Years of the same animal come every twelve years, each with a different element: 1958 (Earth Dog); 1982 (Water Dog); 1994 (Wood Dog). The full list is in our Chinese zodiac years chart.

faq: 1970 is the Year of the Dog, a Yang Metal Dog year (Geng-xu).
When does the 1970 Year of the Dog start and end?
It starts on 6 February 1970 and ends on 26 January 1971.
I was born in January 1970. What is my Chinese zodiac?
A Rooster: Lunar New Year 1970 was on 6 February 1970, so all of January 1970 belongs to the Rooster year.
Metal. 1970 ends in 0, which belongs to Metal, and it is a Yang year.
Who is the Dog compatible with?
Traditionally the Tiger, Horse and Rabbit. The Dog's clash sign is the Dragon.
